exam_name: ServiceNow Certified Customer Relationship Management Architect (CRMA)
passing_score_scale: Scaled score; the cut score is not publicly disclosed and is not always 70%.
exam_price_notes: Registration is payment; learning credits or credit card accepted. Instructor-led training completion includes one free exam attempt.
id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID with full name and photo. Name must match exactly as registered.
exam_rules: Closed-book, proctored exam. No notes, books, or external resources. ServiceNow platform access is not provided during the exam.
renewal_options: Maintain via annual maintenance (delta) exams after each major ServiceNow release and the yearly Certification Maintenance Program (CMP) fee.

retake_policy.notes: A waiting period applies between attempts; the full exam fee is required for each retake. See the Credentialing Program Guide for details.

domains.name: Stakeholder Engagement and Requirements Gathering
objectives: Given a use case, demonstrate the value of CRM implementation in driving digital transformation across an organization

domains.name: CRM Architecture and Platform Alignment
objectives: Given a use case: Select strategies that align with platform and product-leading practices
Identify regulatory requirements relevant to CRM implementation data
Determine the appropriate data model based on the use case and persona
Determine appropriate platform customizations based on the use case and persona
Determine the appropriate organizational hierarchy and location structure based on the use case

domains.name: Integration and Technical Design
objectives: Given a use case: Recommend user-friendly interfaces that support usability across roles and business functions
Apply key performance metrics to evaluate the health and success of a CRM implementation

domains.name: Translation of Business Requirements to Technical Solutions
objectives: Given a use case, recommend CRM solutions that address specific business requirements

domains.name: Hands-on Technical Implementation Expertise
objectives: Given a use case, apply technical expertise to design and implement the future state architecture and process flow

domains.name: CRM Solution Design for Use Cases
objectives: Given a use case: Analyze multi-phase implementation plans and roadmap to determine appropriate sequencing for CRM and ServiceNow platform capabilities
Identify the appropriate record types for specific CRM use cases
Analyze domain separation strategies to distinguish appropriate from inappropriate architectural approaches
Analyze architectural requirements to determine the appropriate domain separation approach
